item.title: Downed tree, power lines close Benjamin Parkway in Greensboro
item.description: GREENSBORO, N.C. (WGHP) — Benjamin Parkway is closed in both directions at West Cornwallis Drive due to a downed tree and power lines, according to the Greensboro Police Department. Motorists are encouraged to avoid this area and find alternate routes of travel. There is no estimated time for reopening.
